selection: Eight fresh confirmation identities, globally unexposed before Round 57, public-screened, sealed-scoreable, and from distinct repositories.
treatment: Unchanged H72 terminal-only request-local evidence handles with exact private resolution and incremental non-disclosure.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and treatment-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: No reruns, replacements, or within-round changes after freeze.
Every identity remains in the fixed denominator.
Stop when six eligible pairs become mathematically unreachable.
Any unbounded usage, ancestry drift, nonterminal boundary, held effect, disclosure, input-reduction, or paired-token violation stops before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 10K unchanged-H72 confirmation only; not 12K qualification, full ContextBench clearance, or production policy.
